evaluations.question: Do all methods with Self-reflection (solid bars) outperform their non-Self-reflection counterparts (hatched bars) in every benchmark?
evaluations.expected_answer: Yes, in all three benchmarks each Self-reflection variant outperforms its base variant
evaluations.model_answer: No, not all Self-reflection methods outperform their non-Self-reflection counterparts in every benchmark. Looking closely, there are cases where the differences are marginal or where a non-self-reflection variant appears competitive. However, the general trend strongly favors self-reflection variants. Specifically, DAPO+Self-reflection consistently outperforms DAPO, and PPO+Self-reflection outperforms PPO across benchmarks, but the pattern holds broadly rather than universally in every single case.
